messages:
Alyssa (CSM): Quick weekly sync on ClearPath — focusing on caching/bundling impact on cost. Can we get last 7d hit rate, avg batch (bundle) size, and cost/1k tokens? Looking for anomalies vs baseline.
Marco (Success Ops): pulling numbers now, will paste the quick snapshot in a sec. Any particular SLA window to check?
Alyssa (CSM): just business hours PST and peak 11a-2p PST. Also flag any error-rate correlations with lower hit rate.
ops-bot: Automated snapshot for workspace:clearpath (7d aggregation)
ops-bot: cache_hit_rate=0.37, avg_bundle_size=3.2, median_latency_ms=120, 95p_latency_ms=420, errors_per_1k=0.8, cost_per_1k_tokens=$0.98
Marco (Success Ops): baseline (last month avg): hit_rate~0.54, avg_bundle_size~4.6, cost_per_1k~$0.72. So hit rate and bundle size dropped; cost up ~36%.
Devon (Infra Eng): that's a meaningful change. Any recent rollout or prompt change from ClearPath?
Alyssa (CSM): They shipped a personalization experiment last Wed that increases prompt prefixes for user context. Might have reduced prefix reuse.
Lina (SRE): lower reuse -> lower prefix cache effectiveness. Also check client-side batching policy; preview shows they switched to more immediate flushes.
Marco (Success Ops): I ran a quick query to segment by route. Top cost routes are /generate/summary and /search/rerank. Both show hit_rate drop ~20-30% week-over-week.
Marco (Success Ops): Query used: ```sql
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as tokens, avg(bundle_size) as avg_bundle, avg(cache_hit) as hit_rate
FROM request_logs
WHERE workspace='clearpath' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route;
```
Alyssa (CSM): good. Could we suggest batching knob changes as an immediate mitigation? Maybe raise max_wait_ms or increase max_bundle_size?
Devon (Infra Eng): yes — safe levers: increase max_batch_wait from 20ms -> 60ms, or set preferred_min_bundle=4. Both should increase avg bundle size and hit rate tradeoff latency. Recommend canary in prod for 24h.
Lina (SRE): we can create a rollout with canary 10% traffic + metrics guardrail: if p95 latency > 700ms or errors/1k > 2 -> rollback.
Marco (Success Ops): I'll prepare the config snippet for ClearPath that sets `max_batch_wait_ms=60` and `preferred_min_bundle=4`. Also include caching TTL tweak: extend prefix cache TTL from 5m -> 20m so recently seen prefixes more likely to hit.
Alyssa (CSM): Nice. Also need an enablement note for their SDK team — they might be responsible for immediate flushes. I'll draft an email with recommended SDK options and the business impact: projected cost drop to ~$0.75/1k if hit_rate returns to 50% and avg_bundle_size 4.5.
Marco (Success Ops): projected numbers with simple model: cost_per_1k * (baseline_hit_rate / current_hit_rate) -> estimate. I'll attach the calc in the follow-up.
ops-bot: Created rollout request #RR-8793, canary=10%, guardrails set, owner=Devon.
Devon (Infra Eng): I'll own rollout. Target start PST 9:30 tomorrow.
Alyssa (CSM): Thanks team. After 12h of canary, drop results here and I'll coordinate customer comms. :thumbsup:
Lina (SRE): noted — I'll monitor latency/error dashboards and add alert for cache hit_rate < 0.4 during the canary window.
Marco (Success Ops): follow-up note: also saw small spike in retried requests (client-side) that correlate with the personalization experiment; we should ask ClearPath to check idempotency keys — those retried requests could reduce effective batching.
Alyssa (CSM): Good catch. I'll add that to the email. End of thread.
